description.value: You've scheduled your life down to the minute, prioritizing your strict deadlines to the point of manifesting mysterious powers that maximize your entire team's the productivity. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Haste] as an 8th-rank occult innate spell that you can cast once per day. When you cast this innate haste spell the first time each day, you can choose to cast it as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell instead of 8th-rank. If you do, you can cast it two more times that day as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
